profile.headline: Frontend Engineer at Bill
profile.summary: Passionate Frontend Engineer skilled in popular Javascript frameworks like React & Angular. Proficient in full-stack development, including GraphQL, SQL, NodeJs, Java, and API integration. Committed to contribute my skills and drive to a dynamic team, fostering innovation and achieving impactful results.

positions.title: Front End Software Engineer/Frontend Developer
positions.description:
🤝 Effectively building software to help employees feel happier at work, using Angular, Jasmine, & Java. 
🚀 Revamping user experience and brand identity through a React, Gatsby, GraphQL, & AWS.
🛠️ Building stronger client relationships by developing internal health metric tools, allowing our team to provide targeted support.
⚙️ Enhancing user experience by increasing web page speed by 40%. Streamline our conversion process to provide more and better qualified leads.

positions.title: Web & App Developer
positions.locationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
positions.description:
• Rebuilt our advisor API by moving it to an external API server, while pulling custom data from our Oracle Database. Simplified SQL queries allowing ease of use for the development team.
• Built a mobile app for our advisors using Angular 8 and Ionic 5, resulting in retainment and addition
 of new advisors.
• Created a customized PWA onboarding portal for companies starting a 401(k) plan. Saved weeks of manual input and caused an incentive to onboard new plans.
• Increased website users 10% by completely rebuilding website for our ABG consultants using Drupal.
• Maintained and updated our core website increasing mobile users by 8%.

positions.title: Web Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Build desktop advisor portal for all plan advisors.
• Work closely with marketing to create social media
 graphics and website blog posts.
• Perform quarterly website updates and customizations
• Design and maintain 60 custom email signatures.
